summary: colinlyguo 提交感知私钥停用的 ecRecover EIP（EIP-8151）：DAI 等不可变的 ERC-2612 permit 合约依赖 ecRecover，EOA 停用私钥后仍可能被旧签名调用。misilva73 提交 EIP-8037 的量化方案与储备模型，EIP-7904 收窄为上调 13 个低效计算操作的 gas 并合并。ACDT #69 报告 bal-devnet-2 已上线，gas 重定价最终数字预计 3 月底。

items.topic: 账户：私钥停用后的签名
items.title: 新增 EIP：感知私钥停用的 ecRecover
items.note: （colinlyguo）提交，Magicians 讨论帖 EIP-8151 13:24：据 EIP-7851 讨论，实现 ERC-2612 permit 的不可变 ERC-20（如 DAI）依赖 ecRecover 验签，EOA 委托后停用私钥，旧私钥仍能通过 permit 动用资产。
items.title_en: Add EIP: Private Key Deactivation Aware ecRecover
items.note_en: (colinlyguo), submitted, with the Magicians thread EIP-8151, 13:24: per the EIP-7851 discussion, immutable ERC-20s implementing ERC-2612 permit, such as DAI, rely on ecRecover, so after an EOA delegates and deactivates its key, the old key could still move assets through permit.

items.title: EIP-8037：加入量化、储备模型并细化 gas 计算
items.note: （misilva73）提交：cost_per_state_byte 取前 4 个有效位量化，避免随 gas limit 频繁小幅变化；以储备模型取代基于回滚的 TX_MAX_GAS_LIMIT，把执行 gas 拆成 gas_left 与 state_gas_reservoir。
items.title_en: EIP-8037: add quantization, reservoir model, and refine gas accounting
items.note_en: (misilva73), submitted: cost_per_state_byte is quantized to its top 4 significant bits to avoid frequent small changes as the gas limit moves, and a reservoir model replaces revert based TX_MAX_GAS_LIMIT enforcement by splitting execution gas into gas_left and state_gas_reservoir.

items.title: EIP-7904：新方法与初步数字
items.note: （misilva73）合并，2 月 3 日提交：由“通用重定价”改名“计算 gas 成本上调”，只上调 13 个低于 60 Mgas/s 的计算操作与预编译。
items.title_en: EIP-7904: new methodology and preliminary numbers
items.note_en: (misilva73), merged after submission on February 3: renamed from General Repricing to Compute Gas Cost Increase, it now raises costs only for 13 compute operations and precompiles below 60 Mgas/s.

items.title: ethresear.ch：用一个参数解决垃圾交易、状态膨胀与费用波动
items.note: （lavender）14:08：提议为执行 gas 设最低基础费，因为扩容后需求常低于 50% 目标，基础费会趋近于零。
items.title_en: ethresear.ch: Solving Spam, State Bloat, and Fee Volatility with a Single Parameter
items.note_en: (lavender), 14:08: proposes a minimum base fee for execution gas, since after scaling demand often sits below the 50% target and the base fee converges to zero.
